notes: Names without suffix (BANK, DAYTON, YORK, CHARLOTTE, FINDLAY, BAYMILLER, GARDEN, AILANTHUS) recorded as '... Street'. Pink Alley is one N-S alley Dayton-Findlay (x~2428-2453): rotated labels read PINK (York-Charlotte) and ALLEY (York Alley-York), i.e. PINK ALLEY reading upward. Charlotte runs only Pink Alley to Baymiller and changes width twice (north line steps at x~3509 and x~4675), so its centreline shifts ~+30 px and then ~+45 px going east. Freeman centre drifts from x~1642 (Bank) to ~1613 (York) from scan rotation. The way east of Baymiller at y~1495 is sheet 216's Dayton Alley (unlabelled here). Hulbert, Garden and the York west leg are drawn only as outlines on the west side of Freeman.
